frontmatter.title: Agentic Memory Management for GPU Code Generation
frontmatter.author: Yahya Emara, Ali Tehrani, Mohamed Abdelfattah
frontmatter.excerpt: This post is part of the AI-Driven Research for Systems (ADRS) blog series. We feature exciting work from Makora this week! We examine the problem of balancing memory and other knowledge sources for GPU kernel generation agents.
